Hayo Zookeepers,
As shared on socials earlier today, we are issuing an immediate patch to resolve a crash linked to the use of Loony Bloons (shop and counter) and Souvenir shops.
Please be aware that your save game is intact and any related issues will be resolved by this patch. Update 1.0.9 addresses this issue and is available now on Steam.
Thank you for your patience while we resolve this issue. It will not affect our current update plan, which can be found on the Under Investigation page.
Bug Fixes

Hayo Zookeepers.

Earlier today we launched Update 1.0.6, which contains a wealth of fantastic fixes addressing a number of high-priority issues. You can find the full list of fixes here, and we have already updated our Under Investigation article to highlight our next planned update. Our team are continuing to work on verifying your reports and implementing fixes, and we will issue regular updates and communicate our areas of focus. Thank you for your ongoing support, everyone at Frontier is working hard on ensuring all our Zookeepers can experience our game at its best.

Unfortunately, following deployment of the update today (23rd October), we received several reports identifying issues when trying to resume a franchise save, preventing full use of the main menu, and creating concern that players’ saved games were lost. If you ran into these issues, please be aware that your saved games have not been lost. Do not delete your saves folder.
For anyone who has installed Update 1.0.6, but is unable to download Hotfix 1.0.7, you can navigate around the issue with the following workaround:
1) Restart the game
2) Enter your chosen mode via the mode's button in the main menu. Do not use the ‘Resume’ button.
Hotfix 1.0.7 addresses these issues. The update is available now on Steam
If you remain unable to access Franchise Mode servers, please ensure you are not running a VPN.

We apologise for the concern which this has caused and thank you for your patience as we work to improve Planet Zoo 2 for all Zookeepers. Once we have worked to address these high-priority fixes, we’ll be sharing news on what future content players can expect, however right now our focus is on tackling those priority concerns.
PATCH NOTES
Fixed an issue whereby selecting the 'Resume' option for a franchise save would display a connection error and subsequently stop the player from loading into any game mode.

Hayo Zookeepers,

Welcome to our first post-launch weekend! We hope you’re all excited to play more and to expand those early zoo concepts into detailed builds! There are some incredible designs already on the Workshop, and as you become more familiar with the new tools we’ve introduced, we can’t wait to see how those designs continue to develop. We’ve been blown away by your support for Planet Zoo 2, with the volume of concurrent players, well above our expectations!

Your support of the Planet Zoo franchise means a lot to us as a studio. Planet Zoo 2 is a milestone for the team that worked on the game, and your appreciation for our work is something we never take for granted.

We apologise for the stability issues that some players have faced in Franchise Mode, and that general game stability has been below what we would expect. The complexity of simulation in our games often means that we see new issues arising as we see our biggest influx of players outside of significant internal testing and user research.

We know that, like us, you want to see our game succeed and to continue to grow. You’ve had moments where the game has sparked the reason you fell in love with our franchise, and moments where you’ve simply been unable to achieve what you set out to create. We acknowledge those frustrations, and our sole focus is on addressing several high-priority areas, listed below.

Alongside today’s Update, we also wanted to provide an initial status update on our current focus. Next week we will share an ‘under investigation’ news post, which will regularly update to highlight key issues from the Issue Tracker which the team are working on fixes for.

Since launch, we’ve worked to address a number of high-priority fixes which were preventing access to Franchise Mode, improving stability and addressing key pieces of feedback to improve your experience. This will continue over the coming weeks.
High Priority Areas
Franchise Mode Stability
Resolving Crashes & Performance Concerns
Save stability, and negating the loss of CC
Re-engaging key quality of life features introduced in Planet Zoo which have not correctly deployed (Ie, edge scrolling and exhibit quick sell/release)
Animal behaviours and animations behaving erratically
Franchise Mode and Frontier Server Connectivity
Since launch we've resolved several key issues specifically linked to Franchise Mode, including;
Increasing the balance between Male and Female animals being added to the animal trading market from Frontier’s Zoos for cash. (Included in today’s Update)
Improving the balance between male and female births within Franchise mode. (Included in today’s Update)
Extending the login window to reduce the risk of server time out while connecting (Included in today’s Update)
Increasing the volume of animals being added to the animal trading market.
Increasing server capacity.

Franchise Mode remains a key priority for our focus. In order to support us in resolving remaining issues, we encourage you to submit tickets on these issues via the issue tracker. Some usernames are also being impacted by our profanity filter due to a banned word being present in the middle of a username, which can also display a server connection error. If this is affecting you, please raise a ticket with our support team.
Please note that if you are using a VPN whilst playing Planet Zoo 2, particularly Franchise Mode, this may also lead to connectivity issues.

Animal breeding frequency and success rate
Shoal welfare requirements
Animal temperature calculations and notifications
Stability & Performance
Various performance and stability improvements
When moving scenery out of a scenery group that would cause the old scenery group to be deleted
When entering and exiting the hub quickly
When attempting to multiselect multiple blueprints at the same time
Several improvements to the undo/redo function including fixing an occasional hardlock caused by selecting undo while using terrain sculpting tools
Resolved occasional inability to place objects after pressing the TAB key on a keyboard
Career
Resolved an issue where later save slots would have the same medal total as save slot 1, prematurely unlocking career levels in that slot
Fixed an issue where scenario data was not being cleared when entering and exiting a different hub
Resolved boxed animals appearing in the opening cinematic of the Great Rift Valley Reserve scenario
Fixed an issue where the next scenario would not always unlock if the player saved and quit before completing it
Resolved audio cutting off unexpectedly during Great Rift Valley scenario
Fixed a localisation issue where the New England scenario incorrectly asked the player to place a souvenir shop instead of a gift shop
Franchise
Resolved inability to list juvenile Shoals for trading in Franchise mode
Fixed issue with the Community Challenge panel not displaying all information
Fixed an issue where release groups would not display the correct CC reward value for completion
Sandbox
Fixed several terrestrial animals being removed when exporting a career or franchise zoo as a sandbox map
Animals
Animals erroneously escaping from habitats
Animal navigation, including a reduction in the frequency animals are automatically boxed
Animal animations, including climbing behaviour
Animal enrichment interactions
Animal breeding frequency and success rate
Shoal welfare requirements
Animal temperature calculations and notifications
Various updates and improvements to the Zoopedia
Updates to animal cohabitation lists
Fixed an issue where some animals did not show injuries after fights or predation
Fixed an issue where some feeder enrichments would not show food for specific species
Resolved Shoals teleporting after they die
Fixed wrong location being shown when entering a nest camera mode
Fixed an issue where juvenile birds in Wildlife Reserves could remain stuck in their nest if their group migrated while they were maturing
Added social group welfare information to shoal info panels
Exhibits
Fixed an issue where guests would use exhibit view points that are not on the path
Park Management
Reduced the interest rates on low level loans
Guests will no longer float when sitting on specific seating
Resolved audio distortion when cycling though heatmap tabs
Fixed inconsistencies between park reputation and animal welfare
Fixed inconsistencies in average donation after the season ticks over
Fixed inability to pause time while in the Cinematic Route Editor camera mode
Keyframe timelines will no longer appear when using the "Hide UI" option in the Cinematic Route Editor camera mode
Improved player experience when navigating the Research menus
Fixed an issue where some guest and staff facilities were not being highlighted in the appropriate heatmaps
Park Construction
Reduced the default angle snap increment to 1 degree rather than 15 degrees
Fixed an issue where placing down a habitat barrier after ysing the nature brush stops mouse and keyboard hotkeys from working until a different interface is opened
Various improvements and fixes to habitat blueprints
Updated the editable area of one of the Grassland sculpted sandbox maps to allow the deletion of the car park
Updated the editable area of one of the Temperate sculpted sandbox maps to allow deletion of the village
Updated the editable area of one of the Tropical sculpted sandbox maps to allow placement further along the beach and the deletion of some buildings
Updated the editable area of the China sculpted sandbox maps to give access to the whole plateau
Resolved object scale tool not functioning correctly with mouse input
Fixed Flexicolour not functioning for the Planet Wood Roof set
The Demolish Brush will remember its set height after closing and reopening the tool
Added a button to switch to removing the waterlogged and snow terrain
Fixed a number of issues with how invisible paths and path extras as being hidden
Fixed an issue where blueprints containing locked enrichment items were appearing before the player completed the appropriate research
Updated Small Steam Train pattern and flexicolour menu
Fixed "Snap to Adjacent Heights" barrier not functioning correctly
Wildlife Reserves
Resolved zoo specific blueprints incorrectly appearing in the object browser while in Wildlife Reserves
Fixed an issue where animals would sometimes teleport in Wildlife Reserves
Workshop
Resolved inability to view creator profiles through the object browser in Career Mode
Resolved chosen thumbnail screenshot not loading when uploading a blueprint to the workshop
Avatar Editor
Added avatar costumes for completing the career
Settings
Fixed an issue where custom keybindings were being reset when opening the Hub, Animal Trading, or Animal Storage
Added customisable keybinding for Scale option under "Object Placement Controls"
Gamepad
Fixed inability to favourite Animal Market listings on Gamepad
Added ability to delete all items in a single multiselected group with a single key
Localisation
Various Localisation fixes
Misc
Various fixes to the first person camera mode
Fixed Autosaves displaying incorrect icons and names
Platform Specific
PC
"Ultra" graphics preset now sets Foliage Detail to Very High
FSR and DLSS should now function correctly when selected in the Graphics menu
